correctness.rationale: For any centered quadratic candidate, cubic dominance forces exact generalized energy preservation. Coefficient comparison reduces every positive-definite weight, up to scale, to \(\operatorname{diag}(a,1,2-a)\) with \(0<a<2\). For this family a permuted Sylvester criterion reduces strict negativity to \(F(a,\rho)>0\). Exact discriminants and rational Sturm counts show feasibility exactly for \(0\le\rho<\rho_*\). The resulting quadratic inequality gives global exponential stability. The source equilibrium quartic has discriminant \(12000P(\rho)\), and exact real-root counts identify \(\rho_*\) as the first nonzero-equilibrium collision. The packaged verifier reproduces all critical symbolic identities and counts.

value.rationale: The result converts a numerically continued event into an exact algebraic and global dynamical boundary. It proves that the origin attracts every initial condition exponentially all the way up to the first saddle-node, and shows that the same event is exactly where the entire class of centered quadratic strict Lyapunov certificates fails. This links the source's energy-preserving structure to its first bifurcation in a sharp, reproducible way rather than adding a routine local calculation.
